```lean
have h1 : x ≠ 1 := by intro h; rw [h] at h'x; exact lt_irrefl (1 : K) h'x
obtain h_sum := geom_sum_Ico' hx h1
rw [h_sum] at h_sum
have h_denom_pos : 0 < 1 - x := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact add_pos_of_nonneg_pos hx h'x
have h_numerator_le : x^m - x^n ≤ x^m := by
  have h_x_pow_le : x^n ≤ x^m := by
    apply nat.le_antisymm_iff.2
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_left hx (le_refl n)) (le_trans (le_refl m) (le_trans (le_refl n) (le_trans (le_refl m) (le_refl n))))
  exact sub_le_self (le_zero_iff.mp h_numerator_le)
apply le_div_iff (le_zero_iff.mp h_denom_pos)
exact h_numerator_le
```
